description: Collect public LinkedIn posts for one or more hashtags. No LinkedIn login or cookie is needed.

authorType.description: Keep only posts written by a person or by a company page. Author type is read from the public author profile link.
authorType.title: Author Type

datePosted.description: Restrict posts to a recent window. Applied by the search index and re-checked against each post's published date.
datePosted.title: Date Posted

dedupeAcrossHashtags.description: Return each post once even when it appears under several requested hashtags. By default a post is returned once per hashtag.
dedupeAcrossHashtags.title: Dedupe Across Hashtags

excludeReposts.description: Drop posts that reshare another post.
excludeReposts.title: Exclude Reposts

hashtags.description: Hashtags to collect. Accepts #AI, AI, artificial-intelligence, https://www.linkedin.com/feed/hashtag/ai/ or .../feed/hashtag/?keywords=ai. Duplicates are removed.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

includeComments.description: Include the first public page of comments (up to 10) with each post. No extra request is made.
includeComments.title: Include Comments

includeVideoTranscript.description: Add the public transcript and caption URL when a video post publishes them.
includeVideoTranscript.title: Include Video Transcript

maxPostsPerHashtag.description: Maximum posts to keep for each hashtag after the hashtag check and filters are applied.
maxPostsPerHashtag.title: Max Posts Per Hashtag

mediaTypeFilter.description: Keep only one post type. Text, image, video, article and repost are the types public posts expose most often.
mediaTypeFilter.title: Media Type

minComments.description: Drop posts with fewer than this many comments. A post with no visible comment count is treated as 0.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Drop posts with fewer than this many reactions. A post with no visible reaction count is treated as 0.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

postedAfter.description: Keep posts published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC day). Leave empty to disable.
postedAfter.title: Posted After

postedBefore.description: Keep posts published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, whole UTC day). Leave empty to disable.
postedBefore.title: Posted Before

sortBy.description: Order the posts found in this run. Relevance keeps the search index order; date and engagement sort only the posts that were found, not all of LinkedIn.
sortBy.title: Sort By

title: LinkedIn Hashtag Posts Scraper Input
